column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_select_card.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Opens the picker's text search, a copy of rel_deck's search dialog: allocates the 0x60-byte search record *0x000196f0 (+0 state, +2 step, +4 focus bits 0-1, +6 UTF-16 query, +0x46 progress, +0x48 extra height, +0x4c main window, +0x50 history window, +0x54 progress window, +0x58/+0x5c filter windows) and the 0x120-byte main window at (0x5e, 0x38), 0x124 x 0x30, title strTbl.bin (resource 0x8033) string 0xa5, caption 0x81, drawer deck_select_card_draw_search_input_box. When the active pane's list (pane record 0x00019ae0 + pane x 0x2c, pane index bits 4-5 of 0x00019aa0) is filtered (list +0x16 bits 6-9) the extra height is 0x27 and the filter windows are opened (ui_open_search_filter_windows); then sizes the window from its content, opens the history window (deck_select_card_open_search_history_window) and sets the picker mode word 0x00019704 to 6. Returns nothing (silently on allocation failure). Side effects: heap (*0x00019a8c), search record, 0x00019704. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_list_tools_submenu).

Per-frame step of the picker's text search by record state: 0 input: Triangle toggles the scope (ui_toggle_search_scope), Left/Right (pad +0xc bits 0x80/0x20) move the focus between the query box (0) and OK (2), Down (0x40) with a history window goes to state 1; confirm on OK chooses it (0x7a05, state 2), confirm on the box opens the keyboard on the query (ui_start_osk_input(query, strTbl string 0x80, 16, deck_select_card_on_search_query_entered)) and on success sets bit 6 of 0x00019aa0 and clears bit 5 of 0x00019adc; cancel marks the main window cancelled and closes the windows (0x7a06, state 3). 1 history list: a chosen entry copies its 0x40-byte string into the query and moves the focus to OK; cancel (-2) or Up at the top returns to state 0. 2 waits until the main window leaves its active state, then starts closing it and the filter windows (state 3). 3 updates the closing main window; once closed (+0xe9 == 6) a cancel frees everything (ui_close_text_search_menu) and sets mode 0x00019704 = 1, otherwise releases the windows and goes to state 4 (search). 4 runs deck_select_card_run_text_search. Returns nothing. Side effects: search record, windows, scope word, sounds 0x7a04-0x7a06, 0x00019704. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_main).

Runs the search on the active pane's list, stepped by record +2: 0 with an empty query sets the list's filter field (+0x16 bits 6-9) to 8 and goes to step 10; otherwise, when the list is filtered and the scope 0x000199a8 is 1, resets the view first (deck_select_card_reset_list_view); with view entries it clears the progress, starts the search (deck_begin_text_search(list, query)), opens the progress window and goes to 1, without entries it begins and finishes at once (deck_select_card_finish_text_search) and goes to 10. 1 waits for the progress window to open (state 3); 2 steps the search (deck_step_text_search) until the progress reaches 1000; 3 finishes it, re-places the pane cursor (ui_place_pane_cursor with the pane's geometry and the new view count) and starts closing the progress window; 4 waits until it is closed. Step 10 (and the end of 4) frees the dialog (ui_close_text_search_menu), calls deck_select_card_open_message(4, view count), plays 0x7a0c and sets mode 0x00019704 = 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: list view, search record, windows, 0x00019704. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_text_search_menu).

Copy of rel_deck's: resets and frees the progress (+0x54) and history (+0x50) windows, releases and frees the two filter windows (ui_release_search_filter_windows, ui_free_search_filter_windows), resets and frees the main window (+0x4c) and finally the search record, clearing *0x000196f0. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees (*0x00019a8c), 0x000196f0. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_run_text_search, deck_select_card_update_text_search_menu).

Counts the non-empty entries of the 8 x 0x40-byte UTF-16 search history at 0x0001974c; with none returns 0. Otherwise allocates (or reuses) the history window (record +0x50, 0x120 bytes) and opens it below the main window (x + 6, y = content bottom + 0xf + extra height), items 0xb0 x 0xe, one per entry, label callback deck_select_card_draw_search_history_item. Returns 1, or 0 on allocation failure. Side effects: heap, history window. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_open_text_search_menu).

Copy of rel_deck's: allocates (or reuses) the progress window (search record +0x54) and opens it at (0x8a, 0x70), 0xcc x 0x30, caption strTbl.bin string 0xa6 in white, no items, drawer ui_draw_search_progress_bar. Returns nothing (also on allocation failure). Side effects: heap (*0x00019a8c), progress window. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_run_text_search).

Copy of rel_deck's: opens the two windows that show the active filter inside the search dialog: window 0 at (main x + 0x15, main content bottom + 1), 0xfa x 0x27, drawer ui_draw_search_filter_label; window 1 at (main x + 0x2e, bottom + 0x13), 200 x 0x12, drawer deck_select_card_draw_search_scope_label; each allocated (0x120 bytes) on first use at search record +0x58/+0x5c. Returns 1, or 0 on allocation failure. Side effects: heap, filter windows. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_open_text_search_menu).

Copy of rel_deck's: calls ui_update_list_window for each existing filter window (search record +0x58, +0x5c; the window pointer is passed in a0, which Ghidra hides). Returns nothing. Side effects: window animation state. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_text_search_menu).

Copy of rel_deck's: draws each existing filter window (search record +0x58, +0x5c) with ui_draw_list_window(list_ptr, window), advancing *list_ptr. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_text_search_menu).

Starts the closing animation (ui_list_window_start_close) of each existing filter window (search record +0x58, +0x5c). Returns nothing. Side effects: window state. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_text_search_menu).

Resets each existing filter window (ui_list_window_reset; search record +0x58, +0x5c) without freeing it. Returns nothing. Side effects: window state. Callers: 2 (ui_close_text_search_menu, deck_select_card_update_text_search_menu).

Copy of rel_deck's: frees each existing filter window from heap *0x00019a8c (the pointers at search record +0x58/+0x5c are left as they are). Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees. Callers: 1 (ui_close_text_search_menu).

column2: void ui_draw_search_filter_label(void *list, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's: drawer of the first search filter window: draws strTbl.bin string 0x84 in white at scale 0xc fitted to width at (x, y) (ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit) inside a font external list on list. Returns nothing. Side effects: font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100 set by ui_open_search_filter_windows).

column2: void ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Copy of the BOOT.BIN pixel wrapper (20 bytes; the decompiler hides its tail call): system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (ui_draw_search_filter_label, deck_select_card_draw_search_scope_label).

column2: void deck_select_card_draw_search_scope_label(void *list, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Drawer of the second search filter window: draws strTbl.bin string 0x83 (scope 0x000199a8 == 0, search the filtered view) or 0x82 (scope 1, search the whole list) in black at scale 0xc fitted to width at (x, y - 2) inside a font external list. Returns nothing. Side effects: font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100 set by ui_open_search_filter_windows).

Copy of rel_deck's: when the active pane's list is filtered (list +0x16 bits 6-9 non-zero) and Triangle was pressed (pad +4 bit 0x1000), toggles the search scope 0x000199a8 between 0 (search the filtered view) and 1 (clear the filter and search the whole list). Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x000199a8. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_text_search_menu).

Draws the text search: in two-pane layouts (low nibble of 0x00019aa0 above 1) shades the inactive pane first (deck_select_card_draw_pane_shade(list, other pane, its list kind)), then the main window (+0x4c) and the progress window (+0x54) when present, and the filter windows (ui_draw_search_filter_windows). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_overlays).

Drawer of the search main window: y is lowered by the extra height (+0x48); when the history window exists it is drawn first, and unless OK has the focus the box blinks (bit 3 of the frame counter selects the v = 0x11 row). Draws the query box from resource 0x8006 (left cap 4 px, body 0xb5 px, drop-down cap 0xf px at x + 0xb9), the cursor frame when the box has the focus in state 0, the query in white at scale 0xc (ui_window_draw_text_px(x + 4, y + 7, 0xb5, query)) and the OK button at x + 0xd6 (ui_draw_list_window_button, highlighted when the focus is 2) with strTbl.bin string 0x20 centred in 0x3c x 0x18 in black. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when the texture is missing). Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100 set by deck_select_card_open_text_search_menu).

column2: void ui_list_window_draw_text(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Copy of the BOOT.BIN helper: draws text from pixel x to the right screen edge, system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_search_input_box).

column2: void ui_window_draw_text_px(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Copy of the BOOT.BIN pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text); the text argument is passed through in its register (hidden by the decompiler). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_draw_search_history_item, deck_select_card_draw_search_input_box).

column2: void deck_select_card_draw_search_history_item(void *list, uint index, int x, int y)
column3: Label callback of the search history window: draws history entry index (0x40-byte UTF-16 string at 0x0001974c + index x 0x40) in black at scale 0xc at x, vertically centred in the item height (history window +0xf2), width = item width (+0xf0), inside a font external list. Returns nothing. Side effects: font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0xfc set by deck_select_card_open_search_history_window).

column2: void * ui_draw_search_progress_bar(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's: drawer of the progress window: draws the bar frame from resource 0x8006 (v 0xf8, 7 px high: caps at x and x + 0xa0, body 0x9c wide at x + 4, all at y + 8) and the fill: width w = progress (search record +0x46, 0-1000) x 0x9a / 1000, with its end caps, the body drawn only when w > 0. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100 set by ui_open_search_progress_window).

Keyboard callback of the search query: when the search record exists, is in state 0 and the query is non-empty, moves the focus (+4 bits 0-1) to OK (2). Returns nothing. Side effects: search record focus. No direct caller (passed to ui_start_osk_input by deck_select_card_update_text_search_menu).
Module entry point of rel_select_card (ELF e_entry 0x1b3c), with nothing to do. Returns 0 at once. No side effects. No direct caller (run by the module loader through e_entry).

column2: void ui_select_card_open(uint mode, int *resources, int *count, ushort *card_ids)
column3: Library entry that opens the card picker: clears the state blocks 0x00019700 (0x3a0 bytes) and 0x00019aa0 (0x6c4); copies resources[0..3] (heap, cip reader, two further handles) to 0x00019a8c/0x00019a90/0x00019a84/0x00019a88; stores mode (0 story card list, 1 caller list, 2 wireless trade) in 0x00019700. Without a caller heap it creates its own FPL (name at 0x00018d18) of 0x600000 bytes (0x800000 in mode 2) and a heap on it (system_heap_create). Stores count (and *count in 0x000199b8) and card_ids in 0x000199b0/0x000199b4 and copies *count ids to 0x000199bc. Sets the thread's VFPU attribute (0x4000), calls deck_select_card_init_resources (resource load start), enables font shadow and colour codes and sets the font wrapping by language (save_get_language), then state 0x00019704 = 0. Returns nothing. Side effects: module state, FPL, heap, font settings. Exported (libselect_card_rel); module callers via import stubs: rel_story (world_state_start_select_card), rel_title (ui_card_trade_open_card_select), rel_conv_machine (0x00000458), rel_labo (0x00000034).

Per-frame entry of the card picker by state 0x00019704: 0 waits for the resources (deck_select_card_load_resources), then hides the loading overlay, starts a 0x10-frame fade-in and in mode 0 releases the low sound banks and plays track 4, state 1; 9 waits for the fade and goes to 10; 10 runs the shutdown (deck_select_card_shutdown) and returns true once it is complete; in other states, unless an exit was requested (0x000199ac), runs deck_select_card_update_card_detail and the main update deck_select_card_update_main. Returns true only when the picker has finished and released its resources. Side effects: those of the callees, fades, music. Exported (libselect_card_rel); module callers via import stubs: rel_story (world_state_update_select_card), rel_title (ui_card_trade_update_picker_result), rel_conv_machine (0x00000458), rel_labo (0x00000034).

Teardown stepped by 0x0001970a: 0 asks the cip reader *0x00019a90 to stop (card_db_cip_request_stop) when bit 0 of 0x00019a94 says it was used (step 1), else goes to 2; 1 waits for card_db_cip_is_idle; 2 releases resources (deck_select_card_release_resources), frees both lists (deck_select_card_free_lists) and, when the module created its own FPL (0x00019a98 > 0), frees and deletes it. Returns 1 when finished, 0 before. Side effects: reader, heap, FPL. Callers: 1 (ui_select_card_update).

Sets the exit-request flag 0x000199ac and, when the picker is running (state 0x00019704 non-zero), forces state 10 (shutdown). Returns true when it was running. Side effects: 0x000199ac, 0x00019704. Exported as ui_select_card_request_exit; module callers via import stubs: rel_title (ui_card_trade_check_session_gate); 3 further import stubs without callers.

Allocates the arrays of a 0x20-byte picker list from heap *0x00019a8c: capacity x 6 bytes of entries at list +4 and capacity x 2 bytes of view indices at list +0x10. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap, list pointers. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_build_lists).

Fills the picker's two lists (0x20-byte records at 0x0001970c and 0x0001972c: +0 index, +4 entries, +8 count, +0x10 view, +0x14 view count) by mode 0x00019700. Mode 0: list 0 = owned cards (deck_select_card_build_owned_card_list, capacity 0xdad), list 1 = save card-list items (deck_select_card_build_card_list_items, 99). Mode 1: list 1 = the caller's ids merged (deck_select_card_add_id_list(..., 0), 99), list 0 = cards with free copies (deck_select_card_build_free_copies_list). Mode 2: list 1 = the caller's ids one per entry (capacity 5), list 0 = free copies minus the caller's ids (deck_select_card_build_free_copies_list_excluding). Then for both lists stores the index, rebuilds the counts (deck_update_list_total), sets view count = count and sorts (deck_select_card_sort_list_view(list, 1, 0)); in modes 1 and 2 also resets list 0's view (deck_select_card_reset_list_view). Returns nothing. Side effects: lists, heap. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_init_screen).

column2: uint deck_select_card_add_id_list(void *list, int count, ushort *card_ids, int separate)
column3: Adds count card ids to a picker list as 6-byte entries {id, image index, copies, flags}: the image index comes from shop_find_in_sorted_table(id, resource 0x8031) and ids without an image are skipped. When separate is 0 an id already in the list only increments that entry's copies (bits 0-6 of byte 4); otherwise every id gets its own entry with 1 copy. New entries clear byte 4 bit 7 and byte 5 bit 0 and are appended to the view. Returns the entry count (0 when card_ids is null). Side effects: list arrays. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_reset_lists, deck_select_card_build_lists).

For card ids 0xe88-0x1f39 computes the free copies (deck_count_free_card_copies) minus the number of times the id occurs in card_ids[0..count-1], and appends an entry {id, image index (shop_find_in_sorted_table with resource 0x8031), copies} for every valid card (card_db_is_valid) with a positive result and an image; also fills the view. Returns the entry count. Side effects: list arrays. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_reset_lists, deck_select_card_build_lists).

For card ids 0xe88-0x1f39 appends an entry {id, image index (shop_find_in_sorted_table, resource 0x8031), copies = deck_count_free_card_copies_2(id)} for every valid card with free copies and an image; also fills the view. Returns the entry count. Side effects: list arrays. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_reset_lists, deck_select_card_build_lists).

For card ids 0xe88-0x1f39 appends an entry {id, image index, 1 copy, byte 5 bits 2-4 = 4} for every valid card whose save flag bit 0 is set (save_test_card_flag_bit0 > 0) and that has an image (shop_find_in_sorted_table, resource 0x8031); also fills the view. Returns the entry count. Side effects: list arrays. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_reset_lists, deck_select_card_build_lists).

Appends one entry per save card-list item (save_get_card_list_count, save_get_card_list_entry): {id, image index (shop_find_in_sorted_table, resource 0x8031), 1 copy, byte 5 bits 2-4 = the item's state (save_get_card_list_state & 7)}; also fills the view. Returns the entry count. Side effects: list arrays. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_reset_lists, deck_select_card_build_lists).

Frees the view (+0x10) and entry (+4) arrays of both picker lists (0x0001970c, 0x0001972c) from heap *0x00019a8c and clears the pointers. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, list pointers. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_shutdown).

Copy of rel_deck's: returns the index of the first entry (6 bytes each, array at list +4, count u16 at +8) whose id equals card_id, or -1. No side effects. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_add_list_entry, deck_select_card_get_target_view_position).

column2: short deck_count_list_copies(void *list, int card_id, int same_name)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's: sums the copies (entry byte 4 & 0x7f) of the list's entries with id card_id and, when same_name is set, also of entries that card_db_is_same_name matches. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_card_row_detailed).

Takes one copy of entry index out of a picker list: refused (returns 0) for list 0 in mode 0 and for an index out of range. With one copy left the entry is removed: its index is dropped from the view (+0x10, count +0x14) and higher view indices are decremented, the count (+8) decreases and later entries move down; otherwise the copies (byte 4 bits 0-6) are decremented. Then rebuilds the list counts (deck_update_list_total). Returns 1 on success. Side effects: list arrays. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_remove_move_source).

Puts a 6-byte entry into a picker list. In mode 0 entries given to list 0 are dropped; list 0 in modes 1 and 2 (and list 1 in mode 1) merges: when the id is already present (deck_find_list_card) its copies grow by the entry's copies, byte 5 bit 0 is ORed in and the index is added to the view if missing; otherwise (and always for list 1 in modes 0 and 2) the entry is appended to the array and the view. Recomputes the total (deck_update_list_total). Returns nothing. Side effects: list arrays. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_drop_card_move, deck_select_card_clear_selection).

Rebuilds both picker lists in their existing arrays from the caller's ids (count 0x000199b8, ids 0x000199bc) with the same per-mode builders as deck_select_card_build_lists, then for both lists recomputes the total, resets the view to the full count, sorts (deck_select_card_sort_list_view(list, 1, 0)) and clears the list's +0x18/+0x1a words and +0x1c/+0x1d nibbles; in modes 1 and 2 resets list 0's view (deck_select_card_reset_list_view). Clears the scroll, column and row of both panes (0x00019ae6-0x00019aea, 0x00019b12-0x00019b16). Returns nothing. Side effects: lists, pane cursors. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_handle_reset_submenu).

In modes 0-2 moves every entry of list 1 (count 0x00019734, array 0x00019730) back to list 0 (deck_select_card_add_list_entry), empties list 1 (count, total and its other fields 0x00019738-0x00019749), recomputes both totals, clears pane 0's scroll and cursor and re-places pane 1's cursor (ui_place_pane_cursor with its geometry and view count). Returns nothing. Side effects: lists, pane cursors. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_handle_reset_submenu).

Copy of rel_deck's: list +0xc = sum of (entry byte 4 & 0x7f) over the entries (array +4, count +8). Returns nothing. Side effects: list +0xc. Callers: 5 (deck_select_card_take_list_copy, deck_select_card_reset_lists, deck_select_card_add_list_entry, deck_select_card_clear_selection, ...).

Writes the result when the picker is confirmed. Modes 1 and 2: when the caller gave a count pointer and id array, writes every copy of every list-1 entry as one u16 id into the array, stores the number in *count (0x000199b0) and clears the "new" state (save_clear_card_new) of chosen cards whose save_get_card_state is 1. Mode 0: replaces the save card list with list 1 (save_set_card_list_count, save_set_card_list_entry, save_set_card_list_state with entry byte 5 bits 2-4). In all modes then writes the 0x200-byte edit block from 0x0001974c (save_write_edit_block) and stores the layout code ui_select_layout_index(panes, layout < 4, pane 0 and pane 1 list flags) with save_set_setting_b1_bits0_2. Returns nothing. Side effects: caller buffers, save state. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_message).

Main per-frame step of the picker. Does nothing while the keyboard is open (bit 6 of 0x00019aa0), while the network layer reports an error (system_get_net_active_flag == 1 and system_net_api_has_error) or while bit 0 of 0x000199a6 is set. Otherwise scrolls the card text (ui_scroll_card_text) and, with no message open (bits 7-14 of 0x00019aa0 zero), dispatches on the mode 0x00019704: 1/7/8 deck_select_card_handle_browse_input, 2 deck_select_card_update_card_move (card move), 3 deck_select_card_update_command_menu, 4 deck_select_card_update_sort_menu, 5 deck_select_card_update_filter_menu, 6 deck_select_card_update_text_search_menu, then updates the cursor rectangle (ui_update_pane_cursor_rect); with a message open runs deck_select_card_update_message. Returns nothing. Side effects: those of the handlers. Callers: 1 (ui_select_card_update).

Browse-mode input of the picker (pad from system_pad_get_state: +0 held, +4 pressed, +0xc repeat): repeated d-pad moves the active pane's cursor (ui_move_pane_grid_cursor or ui_move_pane_list_cursor by the pane's layout flag 0x00019ae4); holding L (0x100) sets mode 7 and runs deck_select_card_handle_pane_scroll_input; holding R (0x200) sets mode 8 and runs deck_select_card_handle_tool_input; otherwise mode 1 and: the cancel button opens message 3 (deck_select_card_open_message, 0x7a0c); the confirm button starts a card move (deck_select_card_start_card_move, 0x7a05 when started); Triangle (0x1000) opens the command menu for the cursor card (ui_get_pane_cursor_entry, deck_select_card_open_command_menu, 0x7a08); Square (0x8000) cycles the pane's list (deck_select_card_cycle_pane_list, 0x7a0d when it changed); Select (1) toggles the active pane between grid and list layout (ui_select_layout_index, deck_select_card_set_layout, 0x7a05). Returns nothing. Side effects: mode 0x00019704, cursors, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_main).

Hold-L handler (pad +4 pressed, +0xc repeat): Square (0x8000) pages the active pane back (deck_select_card_scroll_pane_page(1)), Circle (0x2000) forward (0), Triangle (0x1000) jumps to the previous sort group (ui_jump_pane_to_group(1)), Cross (0x4000) to the next (0), each with 0x7a04; Select (bit 0) on a filtered list (+0x16 bits 6-9) resets the view (deck_select_card_reset_list_view), re-sorts with the list's mode and order (deck_select_card_sort_list_view) and plays 0x7a05. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane scroll and cursor, list view, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_handle_browse_input).

Hold-R handler (pad +4 pressed): confirm starts a card move (deck_select_card_start_card_move, 0x7a05 when started); cancel toggles the save card byte-1 flag of the cursor card (save_test_card_byte1_flag, save_set_card_byte1_flag, 0x7a05); Square (0x8000) opens the sort menu (deck_select_card_open_sort_menu) and Triangle (0x1000) the filter menu (deck_select_card_open_filter_menu), both 0x7a08; Select (1) undoes the last move (deck_select_card_start_undo_move, 0x7a05) when the undo count 0x0001994c is non-zero. Returns nothing. Side effects: those actions, save card flags, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_handle_browse_input).

Copy of rel_deck's: d-pad cursor movement for a pane in grid layout (pane record 0x00019ae0 + 0x2c x pane): Left/Right change the column (+8), Up/Down the row (+0xa); moving past the first or last column hands over to the other pane (ui_switch_active_pane); rows scroll the first visible index (+6) inside the view count, wrapping on a fresh press. Plays 0x7a04 when anything changed. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane record, active-pane bits of 0x00019aa0, sound. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_handle_browse_input).

Copy of rel_deck's: d-pad cursor movement for a pane in list layout: Left/Right switch to the other pane (ui_switch_active_pane), Up/Down move the row (+0xa) and scroll the first visible index (+6) inside the view count using the visible-row count +0x18, wrapping on a fresh press. Plays 0x7a04 when something changed. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane record 0x00019ae0 + 0x2c x pane, 0x00019aa0, sound. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_handle_browse_input).

column2: void ui_switch_active_pane(int pane, uint old_rows, int from_left, uint old_row)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's: makes the other pane active (pane 1 to 0; pane 0 to 1 when the layout nibble of 0x00019aa0 is 2 or more, else 0); the target column becomes the last one when from_left is 1 in grid layout, else 0, and the row is old_row rescaled from old_rows to the target's visible rows. Writes the target pane into bits 4-5 of 0x00019aa0. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x00019aa0, target pane +8/+0xa. Callers: 2 (ui_move_pane_grid_cursor, ui_move_pane_list_cursor).

Pages the active pane (bits 4-5 of 0x00019aa0) by one screen: computes the rows (view count, divided by the column count +0x22 in grid layout) and moves the first visible row by the visible-row count (+0x26 grid, +0x18 list), forward when back is 0 (clamped to rows - visible) and backward otherwise (clamped to 0); stores the first visible index (+6, times the columns in grid layout), or 0 when everything fits. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane +6. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_handle_pane_scroll_input).

Copy of rel_deck's: moves the active pane's cursor to the next (back 0) or previous (back 1) sort group; back passes unchanged in a0 to deck_select_card_find_sort_group_index (Ghidra shows no parameter); a non-negative index sets the first visible index (+6), column (+8) and row (+0xa) so the entry is visible. Does nothing for an empty list. Returns nothing. Side effects: active pane +6/+8/+0xa. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_handle_pane_scroll_input).

Finds the view index of the neighbouring group in the active pane's list under its sort mode (list +0x16 low nibble): the key is deck_select_card_get_group_key(entry, mode), divided by 100 for modes 4 and 5. Forward (back 0) returns the first index after the cursor (ui_get_pane_cursor_index) whose key differs, or -1 at the end; backward returns the first index of the previous group, 0 at the start or -1 at index 0 (modes 4-5 step one entry). With no entry under the cursor returns count - 1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_jump_pane_to_group).

Copy of rel_deck's: in layout modes below 4 delegates to shop_scroll_with_analog(0x00019abc); otherwise, when the text width 0x00019aa4 is positive, moves the marquee offset 0x00019aa8 with the analog value at pad +0x10 (above 0xc0 forward, below 0x40 backward, x 6), else auto-advances 0x40 per frame once the delay counter 0x00019ab4 exceeds 0x35, wrapping at width + 0x76c0. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x00019aa8. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_main).

Copy of rel_deck's: computes the cursor rectangle of the active pane into 0x0001999e (x), 0x000199a0 (y), 0x000199a2 (width), 0x000199a4 (height): grid layout x/y from the pane origin, grid offset and column/row pitch, size 0x17 x 0x1f; list layout from the cell offset and row height, width row width - 3, with the pane-1 special case in layouts below 4. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x0001999e-0x000199a5. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_main).

Opens the picker's message window: clears the 0x120-byte window 0x0001a164 and the 0x800-byte text buffer 0x0001a284 and builds the text from strTbl.bin by kind: 4 filter or search result (string 0x53 when arg is 0, else 0x52 formatted with arg); 3 the leave question with 2 choices (mode 2 string 0xa9, mode 1 string 0xb6 when list 1 holds fewer than 10 cards (0x00019738) else 8, mode 0 string 0x71); 2 a rule message from the u16 table 0x00018d1c indexed by arg. Fills the window layout (font 0xc, black, heap *0x00019a8c), opens it, centres it on the 480 x 272 screen and stores kind in bits 7-14 of 0x00019aa0. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x0001a164-0x0001aa83, 0x00019aa0. Callers: 4 (deck_select_card_start_card_move, deck_select_card_handle_browse_input, deck_select_card_handle_filter_value_window, deck_select_card_run_text_search).

Updates the message window 0x0001a164; when it returns a result (not -1) resets it and, for message kind 3 answered with choice 1, commits the selection (deck_select_card_commit_selection), starts a 0x10-frame fade-out to black, sets state 0x00019704 = 9 and in mode 0 stops the music (audio_stop_sounds_bgm_arg(600)); always clears the message kind (bits 7-14 of 0x00019aa0). Returns nothing. Side effects: window, save via commit, fade, 0x00019704, 0x00019aa0. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_main).
Draws the message window 0x0001a164 with ui_draw_list_window and returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_overlays).

Opens the filter menu: allocates the 0x18-byte filter record *0x0001aa84 (+0 state, +2 sub-state, +3 bit 0 any marked card and bits 1-4 value column, +4 value row, +8 two-word value bitmask, +0x10 menu window, +0x14 value window) and a 0x120-byte menu window (title strTbl.bin 0xa7, 7 items 0xa4 x 0x12, item callback deck_select_card_draw_filter_menu_item) centred at y 0x3a; scans ids 0xe88-0x1f39 for a valid marked card (card_db_is_card_marked) to set +3 bit 0; pre-selects the active list's current filter (list +0x16 bits 6-9 minus 1, 0 outside 0..6) and sets mode 0x00019704 = 5. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap, *0x0001aa84, 0x00019704. Callers: 2 (ui_handle_list_tools_submenu, deck_select_card_handle_tool_input).

Per-frame step of the filter menu (mode 5) by record state: 0 updates the menu window; cancel (-2) starts closing it (state 2), a chosen item i opens the value window for filter i + 1 (ui_open_filter_value_window), plays 0x7a08, clears the cursor, column, bitmask and sub-state and goes to state 1; 1 runs deck_select_card_handle_filter_value_window; 2 waits for the window to close, frees the menu (ui_close_filter_menu) and returns to mode 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: filter record, 0x00019704, sound. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_main).

Value-window step of the filter menu by sub-state (record +2): 0 input over the values first..last of the filter's 8-byte record in table 0x00018d60 (last value excluded for filter 7 without a marked card), grid cursor column (+3 bits 1-4) and row (+4, 0xf = OK) with wrap and 0x7a04; confirm on OK chooses item 0 (sub-state 1), on a value toggles its bit in the bitmask +8 (0x7a05); cancel closes the value window (sub-state 3, 0x7a06). 1 waits and closes both windows (2). 2 when closed: an empty list only stores the filter number in list +0x16 bits 6-9, otherwise filters the view (deck_filter_list_view(list, filter, bitmask)) and re-places the cursor (ui_place_pane_cursor); frees the menu, opens message 4 with the view count, plays 0x7a0c and returns to mode 1. 3 resets the closed value window and reactivates the menu (state 0). Returns nothing. Side effects: filter record, list view, pane cursor, 0x00019704, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_filter_menu).

Copy of rel_deck's: resets and frees the value window (+0x14, if any) and the menu window (+0x10) of the filter record, then the record itself, from heap *0x00019a8c, and clears *0x0001aa84. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, 0x0001aa84. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_handle_filter_value_window, deck_select_card_update_filter_menu).

Draws the filter menu: in layouts with two panes first shades the inactive pane (deck_select_card_draw_pane_shade(list, other pane, its list kind)), then the menu window (record +0x10) and, when open, the value window (+0x14). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_overlays).

column2: void *deck_select_card_draw_filter_menu_item(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Item callback of the filter menu window: draws item through ui_draw_command_item_button(list, 0x00018d28 + (item + 1) x 6, x, y + 1, 0xa4, 0) (a 6-byte label record per filter). Returns the advanced display-list pointer of that tail jump to ui_draw_command_item_button, which ui_draw_list_window stores. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0xfc set by deck_select_card_open_filter_menu).

Copy of rel_deck's: allocates (or reuses) the 0x120-byte value window at filter record +0x14 and opens it for filter 1..7 next to the menu (x = centred menu x + 0x6d, y = menu y + 4 + filter x 0x12, width 0x8a, height 0x19 x ceil(count / 5) + 0x35, count from the table 0x00018d60, 0x19 x 0x19 cells, 5 columns, item callback ui_draw_filter_value_items), with the special sizes of filters 7, 5, 3 and 1. Returns nothing (also on allocation failure). Side effects: heap, filter record +0x14, window. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_filter_menu).

column2: void ui_draw_filter_value_items(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's item-draw callback of the filter value window: draws the caption bar from resource 0x8006, the label of the value under the cursor (ui_get_filter_value_label, scale 0xc, white, fitted to width - 0x15), then for every value of the filter's range (table 0x00018d60, 8-byte records) a check mark (ui_draw_filter_check_mark) when its bit is set in the filter record's bitmask, the cursor frame on the selected cell and the value icon through the filter's draw callback (+4 of the record) at the cell centre, and finally the OK button with strTbl.bin string 0x20. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100 set by ui_open_filter_value_window).

Draws text from pixel x to the right screen edge: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text) (same code as ui_list_window_draw_text at 0x000017f4). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_filter_value_items).

column2: void deck_select_card_draw_text_fit_width_px(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper of 20 bytes whose tail call the decompiler hides; same code as ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit at 0x000012a8: system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_filter_value_items).

column2: void * deck_select_card_draw_icon_800a(void *list, short x, short y, short index)
column3: Draws a 17 x 17 sprite from the texture of resource 0x800a at u = index x 0x11, v = 0, white ambient colour, nearest filtering, at (x, y). Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when the resource is missing). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer, probably a draw callback of the filter table 0x00018d60, hypothesis, confidence medium).

column2: void * ui_draw_icon_grid_7col(void *list, short x, short y, uint index)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's: draws a 17 x 17 icon from resource 0x800b, cell index % 7 across and index / 7 down from v = 0x33. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when the resource is missing). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (filter value draw callback, table 0x00018d60, hypothesis, medium).

column2: void * ui_draw_icon_16px(void *list, short x, short y, uint index)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's: draws a 16 x 16 icon: indices 0xb and 0xc from resource 0x800a with (u, v) pairs from the u16 table 0x00018da8, other indices from resource 0x800c, 8 per row (index above 0xc shifted down by 2). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (filter value draw callback, hypothesis, medium).

column2: void * ui_draw_table_icon_a(void *list, int kind, int x, int y)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's: for kind != 0 draws a 17 x 17 icon described by the 6-byte record 0x00018d28 + 6 x kind (u16 resource id, u8 u, u8 v). Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged for kind 0 or a missing resource). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_pane_status).

column2: void * ui_draw_filter_check_mark(void *list, short x, short y)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's: draws the 26 x 26 check-mark sprite at texture (0x9a, 0xc0) of resource 0x8006 at (x, y). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_filter_value_items).

Copy of rel_deck's: returns the UTF-16 label of value of filter: 1 strTbl.bin string from the u16 table 0x00018db0, 2 card_db_get_race_name, 3 card_db_get_attribute_name, 4 strTbl string from 0x00018dc0, 5 from 0x00018dc8 offset by 4 entries, 6 from 0x00018dc8, 7 card_db_get_genre_name; NULL otherwise. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_filter_value_items).

Rebuilds a picker list's view (+0x10) with every entry index. For list 0 in modes 1 and 2 the save setting save_get_setting_b0_bits6_7 filters it (1: only cards whose save_test_card_byte1_flag is 0, 2: only those with 1); in mode 0 no list is filtered. Stores the view count at +0x14, clears the filter bits 6-9 of +0x16 and sorts with deck_select_card_sort_list_view(list, 1, 0). Returns the view count. Side effects: list view. Callers: 7 (deck_select_card_handle_layout_submenu, deck_select_card_reset_lists, deck_select_card_finish_command_menu, deck_select_card_handle_pane_scroll_input, ...).

Copy of rel_deck's: clears the 0x14-byte search state at 0x0001aa88, stores the list's view count at 0x0001aa8a and text at 0x0001aa94, allocates a result array (count x 2 bytes) at 0x0001aa90 and a 0x10000-byte Horspool shift table filled with 0xff at 0x0001aa98 (heap *0x00019a8c). Returns nothing. Side effects: search state, heap. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_run_text_search).

Copy of rel_deck's: advances the running search by up to 48 view entries, appending matching entry indices (deck_card_matches_search_text with the text *0x0001aa94) to the result array 0x0001aa90 (count 0x0001aa8c). Returns progress in permille, 1000 when finished or without a result array. Side effects: search state. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_run_text_search).

Ends a text search: frees the shift table, copies the result indices into the list's view (+0x10, count +0x14) and frees them, sets the filter field (+0x16 bits 6-9) to 8, and moves the query to the front of the 8-entry history of 0x40-byte UTF-16 strings at 0x0001974c (inside the edit block), removing an equal entry (system_wcslen, system_wcscmp). Returns nothing. Side effects: list view, history, heap frees. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_run_text_search).

Copy of rel_deck's: keeps the view entries for which the predicate at 0x00018de4 + 4 x filter returns non-zero (card id, args[0]); filter 7 uses deck_filter_by_genre(entry, args); stores the new count at +0x14 and filter in bits 6-9 of +0x16. Returns the new count (the old one when the temporary allocation fails). Side effects: list view, temporary heap use. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_handle_filter_value_window).
Copy of rel_deck's filter predicate: true when bit shop_get_frame_style_index(card_db_get_frame(card_id)) (frame category) of mask is set. No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x00018de4).
Copy of rel_deck's: 1 when the card is a monster (card_db_is_monster) and bit card_db_get_race(card_id) of mask is set, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x00018de4).
Filter predicate: 1 when the card is a monster (card_db_is_monster) and bit card_db_get_attribute(card_id) of mask is set, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x00018de4).

Copy of rel_deck's: ORs the u16 level masks at 0x00018e08, 0x00018e0a, 0x00018e0c for mask bits 0, 1, 2 and returns 1 when the card is a monster and bit card_db_get_level(card_id) of that mask is set, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x00018de4).

Copy of rel_deck's: frame 8 with icon 4 -> mask 0x100, icon 1 -> 0x80, icon 0 -> 0x200; frame 7 with icon 0 -> 0x40, 2 -> 2, 3 -> 4, 4 -> 8, 5 -> 0x10, 6 -> 0x20; returns 1 when that mask bit is set, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x00018de4).
Filter predicate: true when bit deck_get_current_card_limit(card_id) (0 forbidden to 3 unlimited) of mask is set. No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x00018de4).

Copy of rel_deck's filter 7: true when masks[0] bit 0 is set and the card is new (save_get_card_state 1); or masks[1] bit 6 is set and the card is marked (card_db_is_card_marked) with artworks (ui_count_card_artworks with resource 0x8032); or its genre words (card_db_get_genres) intersect masks[0] low 16 bits, masks[0] high 16 bits or masks[1] low 16 bits. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_filter_list_view).

Copy of rel_deck's: normalises text (deck_normalize_search_text) and searches it (deck_search_text_horspool) in the card name without ruby, the name's ruby reading, the description without ruby and the description's ruby reading; true on the first match. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_step_text_search).

Copy of rel_deck's Boyer-Moore-Horspool search of a UTF-16 pattern of length units using the 64K-entry byte shift table *0x0001aa98 (0xff = full length); resets the used entries (deck_clear_search_shift_table) and returns a pointer to the match in text, or 0. Side effects: shift table (restored). Callers: 1 (deck_card_matches_search_text).
Copy of rel_deck's: table[pattern[i]] = 0xff for i < length - 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes table. Callers: 1 (deck_search_text_horspool).

Copy of rel_deck's: copies in to out normalised for searching: full-width forms 0xff01-0xff5d become ASCII, katakana 0x30a1-0x30f4 become hiragana (-0x60), other characters go through system_towupper; NUL-terminates out. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 1 (deck_card_matches_search_text).

Applies picker layout layout (0-7): saves the pane state (ui_store_pane_cursors(0 or 2)), takes the 8-byte record 0x00018ea8 + 8 x layout {pane 0 list flag, pane 0 geometry, pane 1 list flag, pane 1 geometry (-1 none)} and copies the 0x1e-byte geometries from 0x00018e10 into the pane records (0x00019aec, 0x00019b18), stores layout in the low nibble of 0x00019aa0, restores each pane's scroll and cursor from its list (+0x18, +0x1c) and re-places them (ui_place_pane_cursor); then re-assigns the lists to the panes (deck_select_card_cycle_pane_list) when the pane count changed, updates the backdrop animation (deck_select_card_update_backdrop_anim) and, when a card is under the cursor (ui_get_pane_cursor_entry), ui_load_cursor_card_text. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane records, 0x00019aa0, lists. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_init_screen, deck_select_card_handle_browse_input).

column2: int ui_select_layout_index(short pane_count, int narrow, short pane0_list_layout, short pane1_list_layout)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's: maps a layout description to the layout index 0-7: one pane gives 0 (list) or 1 (grid); two narrow panes 2 (grid, grid) or 3 (grid, list); two wide panes 5, 7, 6 or 4. Returns -1 for any other combination. No side effects. Callers: 3 (ui_open_layout_submenu, deck_select_card_commit_selection, deck_select_card_handle_browse_input).

Returns the tab box of list list_kind for the current mode and layout: picks the 10-byte record table by mode (0x00018ef0 mode 0, 0x00018f30 mode 1, 0x00018f70 mode 2; 0 for others) and the record list_kind + 0, 2 or 4 by layout group (below 2, below 4, others), and returns x (bits 0-8 of +0) | width (bits 0-8 of +2) << 16. No side effects. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_get_list_slot_position, deck_select_card_draw_pane_shade).

column2: uint deck_select_card_get_list_tab_rect(ushort list_kind, ushort active_kind, ushort *rect)
column3: From the same per-mode tab record as deck_select_card_get_list_box_extent fills rect {x = +4 bits 0-8, y, width = +6 bits 0-8, height}: y 0x19 and height 0xd when list_kind is the active one, else y 0x1b and height 0xb. Returns the x position of the tab's count, x + width - (width - 8 x n) / 2 - 1 with n = bits 9-13 of +6 (the record's character count); returns 0 and leaves rect untouched for a mode above 2. No side effects other than rect. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_list_tabs).

From the same per-mode tab record fills rect {x = +0 + 4, y, width = +4 - +0 - 4, height} with y 0x19 / height 0xd for the active list and 0x1b / 0xb otherwise. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes rect. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_list_tabs).
Returns list_index in single-pane layouts (low nibble of 0x00019aa0 below 2), 2 for layouts 2-3 and 3 for layouts 4 and above. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_backdrop_anim).

Sets the play range (ui_ehf_set_play_range(ehf, i, i + 1)) of the screen's EHF layout chosen by mode (resource 0x1010 mode 0, 0x2010 mode 1, 0x4010 mode 2) to the animation index of the current layout (deck_select_card_get_layout_anim_index with pane 0's list index). Returns nothing. Side effects: EHF player state. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_cycle_pane_list, deck_select_card_set_layout).

Opens the command menu: allocates the 0x18-byte record *0x0001aa9c (+0 bit 0 no card, +2 state, +4 entry, +0x10 window, +0x14 submenu) and a 0x120-byte window titled strTbl.bin 0x72 (mode 0) or 0x87, 7 items of 0xe8 x 0x13 (5 items and 4 px less height without a card), item callback deck_select_card_draw_command_menu_items; disables the undo item when the undo count 0x0001994c is 0 and the clear-filter item when the active list is not filtered (window +0xdc bits); widens it to at least 0xe8, centres it at y 0x3a and sets mode 0x00019704 = 3. Returns nothing (silently on allocation failure). Side effects: heap, *0x0001aa9c, 0x00019704. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_handle_browse_input).

Per-frame step of the command menu (mode 3) by record state (+2): 0 deck_select_card_handle_command_choice, 1 ui_handle_list_tools_submenu, 2 deck_select_card_handle_reset_submenu, 3 deck_select_card_handle_layout_submenu, 4 ui_handle_trunk_option_submenu, 5 deck_select_card_apply_trunk_option, 10 deck_select_card_finish_command_menu (its result is returned). Returns 0 otherwise. Side effects: those of the handlers. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_main).

Copy of rel_deck's: draws the command menu window (record +0x10) and, when open, its submenu window (+0x14) with ui_draw_list_window. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_overlays).

Copy of rel_deck's: resets and frees the submenu window (+0x14, if any) and the main window (+0x10) of the command menu record, frees the record from heap *0x00019a8c and clears *0x0001aa9c. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, 0x0001aa9c. Callers: 2 (ui_handle_list_tools_submenu, deck_select_card_finish_command_menu).

State 0 of the command menu: updates the window; a chosen item (shifted by 2 when the menu has no card, record +0 bit 0) acts: 0 sets bit 0 of 0x000199a6 (card detail view, hypothesis, confidence medium) and keeps the menu, 1 toggles the card's save byte-1 flag (save_test_card_byte1_flag / save_set_card_byte1_flag), 2 opens the list-tools submenu (state 1), 3 the reset submenu (state 2), 4 the layout submenu (state 3), each with 0x7a08; 5, 6 or cancel start closing the window and go to state 10. Returns nothing. Side effects: command record, windows, save flags, 0x000199a6. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_command_menu).

State 10: once the main window has left its closing state, frees the menu (ui_close_card_command_menu) and acts on the last choice: 6 runs the undo (deck_select_card_start_undo_move; when it starts, returns without changing mode), 5 clears the active list's filter (deck_select_card_reset_list_view) and re-sorts it (deck_select_card_sort_list_view with its mode and order); then sets mode 0x00019704 = 1. Returns 0. Side effects: heap frees, list view, 0x00019704. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_command_menu).

column2: int ui_open_command_submenu(ushort title, ushort caption, short item_count, void *item_callback)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's: prepares the command menu's submenu window (record +0x14, allocated as 0x120 bytes when absent): x = main window x + 0x28, y = 0x7c, strTbl.bin caption and title when non-zero, items 0xe8 x 0x13, item_count at +0xcc and the label callback at +0xfc. Does not open it. Returns 1, or 0 when the allocation failed. Side effects: heap, submenu window. Callers: 4 (ui_open_trunk_option_submenu, ui_open_layout_submenu, deck_select_card_open_list_tools_submenu, deck_select_card_open_reset_submenu).

Opens the list-tools submenu: ui_open_command_submenu(title 0x4d, no caption, 4 items (3 in mode 0, without the trunk option), label callback deck_select_card_draw_list_tools_item), sets window flag bit 3 and opens it. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_handle_command_choice, ui_handle_trunk_option_submenu).

Copy of rel_deck's (state 1 of the command menu): updates the list-tools submenu; when a result arrives during its state 3 it starts closing it (and the main window for results 0-2); once closed frees the submenu and acts: cancel returns to state 0 with the main window active, 3 opens the trunk option submenu (state 4), 2 the text search (deck_select_card_open_text_search_menu), 1 the filter menu (deck_select_card_open_filter_menu), 0 the sort menu (deck_select_card_open_sort_menu); the last three also free the command menu. Choices play 0x7a08. Returns nothing. Side effects: command record, windows, the opened tool's state. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_command_menu).

Opens a submenu with ui_open_command_submenu(title 0x86, no caption, 1 item, label callback deck_select_card_draw_reset_item); its result is handled by deck_select_card_handle_reset_submenu. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_handle_command_choice).

State 2 of the command menu: when the submenu returns, resets and frees it; result 1 empties the selection back into list 0 (deck_select_card_clear_selection), result 0 rebuilds both lists from the caller's ids (deck_select_card_reset_lists); both clear the undo count 0x0001994c, close the main window and go to state 10. Cancel returns to state 0 with the main window active. Returns nothing. Side effects: lists, undo count, windows. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_command_menu).

Copy of rel_deck's: opens the layout chooser (ui_open_command_submenu(title 0x45) resized to 0xb3 x 0x43 with 6-pixel margins, drawer deck_select_card_draw_layout_choices); the current layout (ui_select_layout_index) is stored at record +8 and pre-selected; +0xa/+0xc keep the inactive pane and its list index. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window, record +8..+0xd. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_handle_command_choice).

State 3: when the layout window has closed, a cancel re-applies the stored layout (deck_select_card_set_layout_stub(record +8 & 7)), frees the window and returns to state 0; a confirmed layout resets the view of the list at record +0xc (deck_select_card_reset_list_view) when switching from two panes to one, closes the main window and goes to state 10. While open: cancel closes it (0x7a06), confirm chooses the highlighted cell (0x7a05), Up/Down toggle the row and Left/Right move in the 4 x 2 grid, each applying the layout at once as a preview (0x7a04). Returns nothing. Side effects: layout and pane state, windows, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_command_menu).

Copy of rel_deck's: ui_open_command_submenu(title 0xb4, caption 0xb5, 3 items, label callback deck_select_card_draw_trunk_option_item), width 0x108, current choice marked by 1 << save_get_setting_b0_bits6_7() at +0xd8; opens it. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_list_tools_submenu).

Copy of rel_deck's (state 4): when the trunk-option submenu returns, resets it; cancel reopens the list-tools submenu (state 1); a choice is stored at record +0xe, the confirmation is opened (ui_open_trunk_option_confirm), 0x7a0c, state 5. Returns nothing. Side effects: command record, windows. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_command_menu).

Copy of rel_deck's: reuses (or allocates) the submenu window as a confirmation box: caption strTbl.bin 0x34, width 0xf0, button style 3 (+0xca low nibble: buttons 2 and 3) with cancel item 3 (+0xd4) and +0xc8 bit 5 set (cancel moves the cursor to that item), font 0xc black, opened and centred on the 480 x 272 screen. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_trunk_option_submenu).

State 5: when the confirmation returns 2 (yes), stores the choice (record +0xe) with save_set_setting_b0_bits6_7, and in modes 1 and 2 rebuilds list 0's view (deck_select_card_reset_list_view), clearing the cursor of each pane that shows list 0 and the list's saved cursor fields (+0x18, +0x1a, +0x1c); then frees the box, closes the main window and goes to state 10. Choice 3 or cancel returns to state 0. Returns nothing. Side effects: save setting, list view, cursors, windows. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_command_menu).

Returns the advanced list. Side effects: verts, GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_command_menu_items).

column3: 20-byte pixel wrapper whose tail call the decompiler hides (same code as ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit at 0x000012a8): system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_trunk_option_item).

Tail-jump wrapper (instructions: j deck_select_card_set_layout; andi a0, a0, 0xffff; Ghidra shows the target body): applies picker layout layout, truncated to 16 bits. Returns nothing. Side effects: those of deck_select_card_set_layout. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_handle_layout_submenu).

Sets up the picker once its resources are loaded: builds the lists (deck_select_card_build_lists with *count and the id array, or 0, 0), reads the 0x200-byte edit block into 0x0001974c (save_read_edit_block), assigns list 0 to pane 0 and list 1 to pane 1, applies the saved layout (save_get_setting_b1_bits0_2, deck_select_card_set_layout), opens the card view (ui_card_view_open with resources 0x8007, 0x8009, 0x8024, 0x8011, 0x8010 and the cip reader *0x00019a90) and clears the detail globals (0x00019abc = -1, 0x00019ab0, 0x00019ab2, 0x00019ab8). Returns nothing. Side effects: lists, panes, edit block copy, card view. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_load_resources).

Copy of rel_deck's: returns the view index under pane's cursor: first visible (+6) + column (+8) + row (+0xa) x columns (+0x22) in grid layout, first visible + row in list layout. No side effects. Callers: 4 (deck_select_card_find_sort_group_index, ui_get_pane_cursor_entry, deck_select_card_start_card_move, deck_select_card_draw_sort_group_header).

Copy of rel_deck's: returns the 6-byte list entry under pane's cursor (entries +4 through the view +0x10 at ui_get_pane_cursor_index), or NULL when the index is not below the view count. No side effects. Callers: 7 (deck_select_card_handle_tool_input, deck_select_card_update_card_detail, ui_load_cursor_card_text, deck_select_card_run_card_viewer, ...).

Copy of rel_deck's: loads the card under the active pane's cursor into the detail globals (entry 0x00019ab8, id 0x00019ab0, image index 0x00019ab2), copies its description flattened (ui_copy_text_flatten_newlines, 0x314 bytes) into 0x00019b38, stores the overflow beyond 0x4f40 in 0x00019aa4, zeroes 0x00019aa8 and the delay 0x00019ab4; in layouts below 4 sets the text scroller's card 0x00019abc. With no entry clears them (0x00019abc = -1). Returns nothing. Side effects: those globals. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_update_card_detail, deck_select_card_set_layout).

column2: void deck_select_card_cycle_pane_list(uint pane, uint list_index, short direction)
column3: Assigns a list to a pane: with one pane both lists can be shown, so direction 1 / 0 cycles list_index forward or back modulo 2 (other values take list_index as is); pane 1 shows list index + 1. When the list changes, saves the pane cursors (ui_store_pane_cursors), points the pane at the list (0x0001970c + index x 0x20), restores its scroll and cursor from the list (+0x18, +0x1c), re-places them (ui_place_pane_cursor) and updates the backdrop animation. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane record, list cursor fields. Callers: 3 (deck_select_card_set_layout, deck_select_card_handle_browse_input, deck_select_card_animate_card_move).

column2: void ui_place_pane_cursor(short keep_cursor, uint index, uint geometry, uint count, ushort *top, ushort *column, ushort *row)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's: clamps a pane's scroll and cursor to count entries (geometry: columns in the low byte, visible rows in the high byte) and makes index (or with keep_cursor the current cursor) visible, writing *top, *column and *row. Returns nothing. Side effects: *top, *column, *row. Callers: 6 (deck_select_card_handle_filter_value_window, deck_select_card_cycle_pane_list, deck_select_card_set_layout, deck_select_card_clear_selection, ...).

Copy of rel_deck's: saves pane cursors into the lists they show (which != 1 pane 0, which != 0 pane 1): first visible to list +0x18, column and row nibbles to +0x1c, the absolute cursor index to +0x1a and the column count to the low nibble of +0x1d. Returns nothing. Side effects: list records +0x18..+0x1d. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_cycle_pane_list, deck_select_card_set_layout).

Pushes a 10-byte undo record on the 8-deep stack at 0x0001994e (count 0x0001994c); when full, drops the oldest by moving the others down. Returns nothing. Side effects: undo stack. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_start_card_move).

When the undo stack is not empty, decrements its count 0x0001994c and copies the top 10-byte record to out. Returns true when a record was popped. Side effects: undo count, out. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_start_undo_move).

Returns (n - 1) / 2 + 1 (n itself when n - 1 is negative, then halved) capped at 99, with n the word at save state +0xfdf4 (save_get_state). Used as the mode-0 maximum of list 1 (the save card list). No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_start_card_move).

Starts moving the card under the active pane's cursor to the other list. Refuses with message 2 / 3 (deck_select_card_open_message, 0x7a0c) when list 1 is full: mode 2 above 4 entries, mode 1 above 0x62 copies, mode 0 at the capacity from deck_select_card_get_card_list_capacity; in mode 0 only entries whose byte 5 bits 2-4 equal 4 can move. Allocates the 0x34-byte move record *0x0001aaa0 (+0 state, +2 entry index, +4 view index, +6 source pane bits 0-1, source list bits 2-4, target pane bits 5-6, target list bits 7-9, +8 target list index, +0xe entry copy, +0x18/+0x28 start and target positions as floats, +0x30/+0x32 drawn position), pushes the undo record {source | target << 4, entry, target position deck_select_card_get_target_view_position} (deck_select_card_push_undo_move), sets mode 0x00019704 = 2, computes both slot positions (deck_select_card_get_list_slot_position; state 1 when the target is off screen, 2 otherwise) and takes the card out of its source (deck_select_card_remove_move_source). Returns 1 when started, 0 otherwise. Side effects: heap, move record, undo stack, lists, 0x00019704. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_handle_tool_input, deck_select_card_handle_browse_input).

Undo: pops the last 10-byte record (deck_select_card_pop_undo_move: byte 0 = source list | target list << 4, entry index, 6-byte entry copy) and starts the reverse move: allocates the 0x34-byte move record *0x0001aaa0 with source = the record's target list and target = its source list (panes chosen by the layout), finds the entry in that list (by the stored index when the id and byte-4 bit 7 still match, else by scanning backwards) and its view index, computes the start position (deck_select_card_get_list_slot_position), sets mode 0x00019704 = 2 and state 2, and takes the card out (deck_select_card_remove_move_source). Returns 1 when started, 0 without a record or on allocation failure. Side effects: heap, move record, undo stack, lists, 0x00019704. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_handle_tool_input, deck_select_card_finish_command_menu).

Mode-2 handler by move record state (low nibble of byte 0): 1 waits the scroll step (+0x14 low 3 bits) frames per call, then asks for the target slot position (deck_select_card_get_list_slot_position with scrolling) and, once visible, takes the drawn position and goes to state 2; 2 runs the flight (deck_select_card_animate_card_move); 3 frees the record (deck_select_card_free_card_move) and returns to mode 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: move record, pane scroll, 0x00019704. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_main).

Takes one copy of the moving entry out of its source list: deck_select_card_take_list_copy(0x0001970c + source list x 0x20, record +2). Returns nothing. Side effects: list arrays. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_start_undo_move, deck_select_card_start_card_move).

Copies the moving entry (record +0xe), sets its copies to 1 and byte 5 bit 0, and adds it to the target list (deck_select_card_add_list_entry(0x0001970c + target list x 0x20, entry)). Returns nothing. Side effects: list arrays. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_animate_card_move).

Flight of the moving card by sub-step (high nibble of record byte 0): 0 computes the target position (deck_select_card_get_list_slot_position with deck_select_card_get_target_view_position) and the Bezier control point +0x20/+0x24 (half-way with a 120 px horizontal or 68 px vertical offset depending on how far apart start and target are); 1 interpolates the quadratic Bezier over 10 frames into the drawn position +0x30/+0x32; 2 shows the target list in a single-pane layout (deck_select_card_cycle_pane_list), drops the card (deck_select_card_drop_card_move), re-clamps both pane cursors (ui_place_pane_cursor) and sets state 3. Returns nothing. Side effects: move record, lists, pane cursors. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_card_move).

Frees the move record *0x0001aaa0 from heap *0x00019a8c when present and clears the pointer. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap, 0x0001aaa0. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_update_card_move, deck_select_card_start_undo_move).

While the move record is in state 2, draws the flying card (shop_draw_card_thumb with the entry copy +0xe and resources 0x8001, 0x8002, 0x8032) at the drawn position (+0x30 - 0xb, +0x32 - 0xf). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_overlays).

column2: int deck_select_card_get_list_slot_position(float *out, int pane, uint list, int index, int scroll)
column3: Computes the screen position of view index index of list in pane into out[0..1] (floats, slot centre: +11, +15): grid layout from the pane origin, grid offset and column/row pitch, list layout from the cell offset and row height. When the pane shows another list returns the list's tab position (deck_select_card_get_list_box_extent, y 32). When the index is outside the visible window and scroll is set (not for list 0), scrolls the pane by one row (columns in grid layout) towards it, stores the step (1 or 6 frames) in move record +0x14 and returns 0. Returns 1 when out was written. Side effects: pane scroll, move record +0x14. Callers: 4 (deck_select_card_update_card_move, deck_select_card_start_undo_move, deck_select_card_start_card_move, deck_select_card_animate_card_move).

Returns the view position where card_id will appear in picker list list: lists that merge entries (list 0 in modes 0 and 2, both lists in mode 1) return the view index of the existing entry (deck_find_list_card), otherwise (and when absent) the current view count. No side effects. Callers: 3 (deck_select_card_update_card_move, deck_select_card_start_card_move, deck_select_card_animate_card_move).

Per-frame detail logic: unless the card viewer is requested (0x000199a6 bit 0), counts frames in 0x00019ab4 and after 16 sets bit 0 of byte 5 of the shown entry (seen), and reloads the card text (ui_load_cursor_card_text) when the card under the cursor changed and no sort menu is open (0x00019aac bit 0); with the request set runs deck_select_card_run_card_viewer. Returns nothing. Side effects: entry flags, detail globals. Callers: 1 (ui_select_card_update).

Full-screen card viewer stepped by 0x00019708: 0 starts a 0x10-frame fade-out; 1 when faded opens the viewer for the cursor card (ui_card_viewer_open(id, resource 0x800c, 0x8012), ui_card_viewer_set_pack_source(0x8015), ui_card_viewer_enable_artwork_select) and sets bit 0 of 0x00019adc; 2 updates it until it ends, clears the bit and fades in; 3 when faded clears the step and bit 0 of 0x000199a6. Returns nothing. Side effects: viewer, fades, 0x00019708, 0x00019adc, 0x000199a6. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_card_detail).
Copy of the BOOT.BIN comparator: returns *a - *b (u16, ascending). No side effects. No direct caller (qsort callback of deck_select_card_init_resources).

column2: int ui_deck_find_resource(ushort id, void *table, int count)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's: binary search of count 12-byte resource records (u16 id at +0, ascending) for id. Returns the record index or -1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_get_resource).

Clears the loader byte 0x0001aab0 and sets its bit 0 (loader idle), then sorts the resource tables with system_qsort and deck_compare_u16_ascending: 0x29 records at 0x00019338 (ids 0x8xxx) and one record each at 0x00019534 (0x1xxx), 0x00019540 (0x2xxx) and 0x0001955c (0x4xxx). Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x0001aab0, tables. Callers: 1 (ui_select_card_open).

Stepped resource loader (step = bits 1-7 of 0x0001aab0, bit 0 = no load pending): 0 takes archive 1 from the caller (0x00019a84) or loads it (deck_select_card_load_archive); 1 takes the mode's archive (2 mode 0, 3 mode 1, 4 mode 2) from the caller (0x00019a88) or loads it; 2 opens the card-image reader when none was given (0x135000-byte buffer 0x0001aab4, card_db_open_cardh_cip, flag 0x00019a94 bit 0) or skips to 4; 3 waits for card_db_cip_is_ready; 4 runs deck_select_card_init_screen and returns 1. Returns 0 while loading. Side effects: heap, archives, reader, loader byte. Callers: 1 (ui_select_card_update).
Empty function (returns at once). No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_shutdown).

Library exit of the picker: frees the card-image reader buffer *0x0001aab4 and every archive of the 4-record table 0x00019068 that the module loaded itself (record id 1 is supplied by the caller through 0x00019a84, the others through 0x00019a88; supplied ones are not freed), clearing the pointers. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, table pointers. Exported (libselect_card_rel); module callers via import stubs: rel_title (ui_card_trade_release); 3 further import stubs without callers.

Returns the 12-byte archive record {u16 id, data pointer +4, path format +8} with id among the 4 records at 0x00019068, or NULL. No side effects. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_load_archive, deck_select_card_load_resources).

Returns the archive's data pointer when it is loaded; otherwise, when no load is pending (bit 0 of 0x0001aab0), formats its path with the language letter ("jegfis"[save_get_language()]), clears the bit, allocates the file size (container_get_file_size(3, path)) and starts container_load_file(3, path, buffer, size, deck_select_card_on_archive_loaded, buffer). Returns 0 while not loaded. Side effects: heap, archive record, loader byte, file request. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_get_resource, deck_select_card_load_resources).

Resource lookup used by the whole module: picks the table by the id's high bits (0x8000: 0x29 records at 0x00019338; 0x1000, 0x2000, 0x4000: the single records at 0x00019534, 0x00019540, 0x0001955c), finds the 12-byte record {u16 id, u16 archive id, cached pointer, member-name format} (ui_deck_find_resource) and, when not cached, gets its archive (deck_select_card_load_archive), formats the member name with the language letter (ids 0x8036/0x8037 with a fixed letter from the string at 0x00019568) and caches container_ehp_find_member. Returns the member pointer or 0. Side effects: record cache, archive loads. Callers: 53 (ui_draw_icon_grid_7col, ui_open_command_submenu, deck_select_card_draw_overlays, deck_select_card_open_filter_menu, ...).

File-load callback of deck_select_card_load_archive: when size is positive binds the EHP archive (container_ehp_bind_with_callback(0, data)) and advances the loader step of 0x0001aab0, setting bit 0 again. Returns size > 0. Side effects: 0x0001aab0, archive binding. No direct caller (container_load_file callback).

Opens the sort menu for the active pane's list: allocates the 0x18-byte sort record *0x0001aab8 (+0 state, +2 focus bits 0-1, +4 saved view copy, +8 saved mode bits 0-5 and order bits 6-7, +0xc key window content bottom, +0x10 key window, +0x14 direction window), a key window (title strTbl.bin 0xa8, 10 items 0x88 x 0x12, label callback deck_select_card_draw_sort_key_item, centred at y 0x3a) and a direction window to its right (2 items, width from strings 0x61/0x62 + 0x19, capped at x 0x1d0, callback deck_select_card_draw_sort_order_item). Saves the view and the list's sort mode and order, pre-selects them, positions the direction window (shop_place_sort_order_window), sets mode 0x00019704 = 4 and bit 0 of 0x00019aac. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap, *0x0001aab8, 0x00019704, 0x00019aac. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_handle_tool_input, ui_handle_list_tools_submenu).

Mode-4 handler: state 1 updates both closing windows and, once closed, frees them (shop_close_results_sort_menu), returns to mode 1 and clears bit 0 of 0x00019aac. State 0: keeps the direction window aligned, updates the focused window (focus +2: 0 keys, Right moves to the direction window; 1 direction, Left moves back; L/R toggle the direction), and whenever the key or direction changes restores the saved view and re-sorts it live (deck_select_card_sort_list_view(list, key + 1, direction)). A result closes both windows (state 1): cancel restores the saved view, mode and order, a choice re-sorts with the chosen key and direction. Returns nothing. Side effects: list view and sort bits, windows, sounds 0x7a04. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_main).

Copy of rel_shop's: resets the two list windows of the sort record *0x0001aab8 (+0x14, +0x10), frees both and the record from heap *0x00019a8c and clears 0x0001aab8. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, 0x0001aab8. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_update_sort_menu).

Draws the sort menu: in two-pane layouts shades the inactive pane (deck_select_card_draw_pane_shade), then the key window (+0x10) and the direction window (+0x14). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_overlays).

column3: Label callback of the sort key window: ui_draw_command_item_button(list, 0x00019570 + (item + 1) x 6, x, y + 1, 0x88, 0). Returns the advanced display-list pointer of that tail jump to ui_draw_command_item_button, which ui_draw_list_window stores. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0xfc).

column3: Label callback of the sort direction window: ui_draw_command_item_button(list, 0x000195b4 + item x 6, x, y + 1, item width of the window, 0). Returns the advanced display-list pointer of that tail jump to ui_draw_command_item_button, which ui_draw_list_window stores. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0xfc).

Copy of rel_shop's: positions the direction window (+0x14) of the sort record so that it lines up with the selected key row: y = record +0xc + item height / 2 + selected key x item height - window height / 2. Returns nothing. Side effects: direction window +0x5a. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_open_sort_menu, deck_select_card_update_sort_menu).

column2: void * deck_select_card_draw_sort_key_icon(void *list, int key, int x, int y)
column3: For key != 0 draws the 17 x 17 icon of sort key key from the 6-byte record 0x00019570 + 6 x key (u16 resource id, u8 u, u8 v). Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged for key 0 or a missing resource). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_pane_status).

column2: void * shop_draw_sort_order_icon(void *list, int key, int x, int y)
column3: Copy of rel_shop's: draws the 17 x 17 icon of record key of the table 0x000195b4 (u16 resource id, u8 u, u8 v) at (x, y). Returns the advanced list (unchanged when the image is missing). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_pane_status).

column2: void deck_select_card_sort_list_view(void *list, int mode, uint order)
column3: Sorts a list's view: builds a temporary array of 8-byte records {view entry, position, key = deck_select_card_get_sort_key(entry, mode)}, sorts it with qsort (order 0 deck_select_card_compare_sort_key_asc, 1 deck_select_card_compare_sort_key_desc), writes the entries back to the view and stores mode in bits 0-3 and order in bits 4-5 of +0x16. Returns nothing. Side effects: list view, temporary heap. Callers: 6 (deck_select_card_finish_command_menu, deck_select_card_reset_list_view, deck_select_card_build_lists, deck_select_card_handle_pane_scroll_input, ...).

qsort comparator of {u16 entry, u16 position, s32 key} records: keys ascending, key -2 (not applicable) always last, equal keys by original position. Returns -1, 0 or 1. No side effects. No direct caller (passed to system_qsort by deck_select_card_sort_list_view).
Like deck_select_card_compare_sort_key_asc with keys and positions in descending order, key -2 still last. Returns -1, 0 or 1. No side effects. No direct caller (qsort callback).

Sort key of a list entry: 1 card_db_get_sort_position, 2 frame, 3 0xffff - level, 4 0xffff - ATK and 5 0xffff - DEF (0x10000 when unknown), 6 race, 7 attribute, 8 the spell/trap icon order from the byte tables 0x000195c8 (frame 8) and 0x000195c0 (frame 7), 9 deck_get_current_card_limit, 10 0xffff - copies; -2 for keys that do not apply to the card (monster keys on spells and traps and the reverse). No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_sort_list_view).

Group key of a list entry for the group jump: 1 card_db_get_top_group, 2 frame, 3 level, 4 ATK and 5 DEF (-1 when unknown), 6 race, 7 attribute, 8 icon (0 mapped to 7) for spells and traps, 9 limit, 10 copies; -2 when not applicable. No side effects. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_find_sort_group_index, deck_select_card_draw_sort_group_header).

Copy of rel_deck's: draws the information on the card under the cursor (card points at the id 0x00019ab0). Layouts 0-3: the big detail view (ui_draw_card_detail_view_temp(list, 0x00019abc)) plus the byte-1 flag badge at (0x7b, 0x87). Layouts 4-7: a bottom strip with attribute, race or property icon, level badge and ATK/DEF for monsters, the flag badge, the name and type line, and the flattened description 0x00019b38 as a marquee shifted by 0x00019aa8. Nothing for card id 0. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 2 (ui_select_card_ae4aa6ec, ui_select_card_draw).

column2: void ui_card_info_draw_text_fit_width(int x, int y, int width, ushort *text)
column3: Tail-jump wrapper (Ghidra shows an empty body; instructions: j system_font_draw_text_fit_width; li t0, -1): calls system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x, y, width, text, -1) with the coordinates already in 1/64 pixel; t0 = -1 selects the scale-reducing path. Same code as rel_deck ui_card_info_draw_text_fit_width. Side effects: font commands (the card type line is drawn). Callers: 1 (ui_draw_cursor_card_info).

Callers: 3 (ui_draw_cursor_card_info, deck_select_card_draw_card_row_detailed, deck_select_card_draw_sort_group_header).

Callers: 3 (ui_draw_cursor_card_info, deck_select_card_draw_card_row_detailed, deck_select_card_draw_sort_group_header).

column2: void * deck_select_card_draw_attribute_icon(void *list, uint x, int y, short attribute)
column3: Draws the attribute icon at (x, y) with the texture of resource 0x8007 (shop_draw_attribute_icon). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 3 (ui_draw_cursor_card_info, deck_select_card_draw_card_row_detailed, deck_select_card_draw_sort_group_header).

column3: Copy of rel_deck's: draws group-header icon set A at (x, y) with resource 0x800a (shop_draw_results_label_icon_a). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_sort_group_header).

column3: Copy of rel_deck's: draws group-header icon set B at (x, y) with resource 0x8009 (ui_draw_group_header_sprite_b). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_sort_group_header).
