column2: void * ui_draw_command_item_button(void *list, ushort *item, int x, int y, int width, uint color)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's: builds a 0x10-byte button record from the 6-byte item record (u16 resource id, u8 u, u8 v, u16 strTbl.bin string): texture, 17 x 17 icon at (u, v), text, colour (0 = default black), and draws it with shop_draw_menu_item_box at (x, y) with width. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 7 (deck_select_card_draw_reset_item, deck_select_card_draw_list_tools_item, deck_select_card_draw_command_item_label, deck_select_card_draw_filter_menu_item, ...).

column2: void * deck_select_card_draw_pane_shade(void *list, uint pane, ushort list_index)
column3: Darkens a pane while a dialog has focus: with texturing off, texture function 4 and colour 0x80000000 draws a rectangle over the pane (pane record +0xc x, +0xe y, +0x10 width, +0x12 height) and over its list's tab (x = pane x + the box offset from deck_select_card_get_list_box_extent, y 0x17, the box width, height 0xf), then restores texturing, texture function and white ambient colour. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (Ghidra shows void). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 3 (deck_select_card_draw_filter_menu, deck_select_card_draw_sort_menu, deck_select_card_draw_text_search_menu).

While scrolling with L (mode 7), draws the group key of the card under the active cursor in a box (ui_draw_nine_slice_frame with resource 0x8013) sized by the sort mode and placed on the pane's right edge at the cursor's relative height: mode 1 the initial (card_db_get_top_letter), 2 the frame group icon, 3 the level badge, 4/5 ATK/DEF rounded down to 100, 6 race, 7 attribute, 8 property, 9 limit icon, 10 the copy count. Nothing without an entry or for key -2. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_overlays).

Library draw entry: in states 0 and 10 only clears layer 0 to black; while the card viewer runs (0x00019adc bit 0) draws it (ui_card_viewer_draw); otherwise clears layer 0 and draws on layer 4 the background (deck_select_card_draw_background), the cursor card information, the panes (ui_draw_editor_panes) and the overlays, then the fade. While the keyboard is open (0x00019aa0 bit 6) it first captures the screen once (ui_capture_screen_backdrop, 0x00019adc bit 5) and then only draws the keyboard (ui_draw_captured_backdrop) and polls it (ui_update_osk_input(4)), clearing bit 6 when it closes. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE layers, keyboard state. Exported (libselect_card_rel); module callers via import stubs: rel_story (world_state_update_select_card), rel_title (ui_title_draw_module_overlays), rel_conv_machine (ui_conv_machine_draw); 1 further import stub without callers.

Alternative draw entry that returns the display list instead of committing it: same drawing as ui_select_card_draw on layer 4 (background, card info, panes, overlays, fade) and returns the list pointer with *drawn = 1; in states 0/10, while the card viewer runs, or while the keyboard is open (polled with ui_update_osk_input(4)) it commits or delegates and sets *drawn = 0. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (0 in states 0/10). Side effects: GE layers. Exported (libselect_card_rel); 4 import stubs without callers.

Draws the picker's overlays: in modes 1, 7 and 8 the blinking cursor frame (shop_draw_cursor_frame with the rectangle 0x0001999e-0x000199a4 and resource 0x8006); then by mode 2 the flying card, 3 the command menu, 4 the sort menu, 5 the filter menu, 6 the text search, 7/8 the L or R help panel (shop_draw_button_help with resources 0x8013 and 0x8033, positioned away from the cursor; mode 7 adds the group header); finally the message window when one is open. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 2 (ui_select_card_ae4aa6ec, ui_select_card_draw).

Chains the background layers: deck_select_card_draw_backdrop, deck_select_card_draw_mode_layout, ui_draw_list_row_stripes (layout nibble), deck_select_card_draw_title and deck_select_card_draw_pane_status. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (Ghidra shows void). Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 2 (ui_select_card_ae4aa6ec, ui_select_card_draw).

Plays the backdrop EHF layout of resource 0x8021 (ui_ehf_begin_draw, ui_ehf_draw with a 0x60-byte parameter block holding the frame counter, ui_ehf_end_draw), then restores texturing, texture function and alpha blending. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when the resource is missing). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_background).

Plays the EHF layout of the current mode (resource 0x1010 mode 0, 0x2010 mode 1, 0x4010 mode 2) with the frame counter (ui_ehf_draw); its animation range is chosen by deck_select_card_update_backdrop_anim. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_background).

Copy of rel_deck's: draws the faint row separators of list-layout panes as line pairs from 0x240 bytes of inline data (layout 0: seven rows at x 0x97, width 0x13d; layouts 4/6: six rows at x 3; layouts 4/7: six rows at x 0xf3; width 0xe1, from y 0x29 every 0x1e px). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_background).

column2: void ui_fill_row_stripe_vertices(void *vertices, short x, short y, short width)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's: writes four 12-byte vertices for two horizontal lines from x to x + width (colour 0x33000000 at y, 0x19000000 at y + 1). Returns nothing. Side effects: writes 0x30 bytes. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_list_row_stripes).

Draws the screen title in white at scale 0xc, fitted (deck_select_card_draw_text_fit_width_px_3) at x 0x99 (layouts 0-3) or 5 (layouts 4-7), y 5: strTbl.bin string 0xaa (width 0xf6) in mode 2, 9 in mode 1, 0x74 in mode 0 (width 0x142). Returns nothing. Side effects: font commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_background).

column2: void deck_select_card_draw_text_fit_width_px_3(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: 20-byte pixel wrapper whose tail call the decompiler hides (same code as ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit at 0x000012a8): system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_draw_list_tab_label, deck_select_card_draw_title).

Draws the status strip under each visible pane: sort key icon (deck_select_card_draw_sort_key_icon) and order icon (shop_draw_sort_order_icon), the filter icon (ui_draw_table_icon_a) with the view count (shop_draw_small_digits, blinking while message 4 is shown for that pane), the trunk-option badge (save_get_setting_b0_bits6_7, resource 0x800a) for list 0 in modes 1 and 2, and the scroll bar (shop_draw_scrollbar with first row, visible rows and row count); then the list tabs (deck_select_card_draw_list_tabs). Returns the advanced display-list pointer (Ghidra shows void). Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_background).

Draws the tabs of both lists: with one pane both tabs above pane 0 (the shown one active), with two panes one tab per pane; each tab gets its total count (ui_draw_list_tab_count with the digit count from the per-mode u16 table 0x000195d0/0x000195d4/0x000195d8 and the list total +0xc) and its label (deck_select_card_draw_list_tab_label) inside the rectangles from deck_select_card_get_list_tab_rect and deck_select_card_get_list_label_rect. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_pane_status).

column2: void * ui_draw_list_tab_count(void *list, short x, short *rect, int digits, int value)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's: when rect (x, y, w, h) is not empty, scissors to it and draws value as black digits (scale 0xb x 0xc, pitch 8, digits positions) ending at x, at y + 1. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_list_tabs).

column2: void * deck_select_card_draw_list_tab_label(void *list, ushort list_index, ushort active_index, short *rect, int mode, short pane_x)
column3: When rect is not empty, scissors to it and draws the tab label strTbl.bin string *(0x000195dc + mode x 4 + list_index x 2) at scale 0xc fitted to the width, white for the active list and 0xffbfbfbf otherwise. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_list_tabs).

Copy of rel_deck's: draws pane 0 as a thumbnail grid (deck_select_card_draw_card_grid) or detailed rows (deck_select_card_draw_list_rows_detailed) by its layout flag; in two-pane layouts pane 1 as a grid, compact rows (deck_select_card_draw_list_rows_compact, layouts 2-3) or detailed rows. The pane record is passed in a1, hidden by the decompiler. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 2 (ui_select_card_ae4aa6ec, ui_select_card_draw).

Draws the visible rows of a list-layout pane: from the first visible view index (+6) up to the visible-row count (+0x18) or the end of the list, one detailed row per entry (deck_select_card_draw_card_row_detailed at pane x + cell offset, y advancing by the row height +0x1c, width +0x1a). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_panes).

Draws the visible thumbnails of a grid pane: rows (+0x26) x columns (+0x22) from the first visible index, each with shop_draw_card_thumb (resources 0x8001, 0x8002, 0x8032) and its decorations (shop_draw_card_badges with resources 0x8009, 0x800a). In mode 0 entries whose card-list state (byte 5 bits 2-4) is not 4 are tinted 0xa0ffffff and get that state as a badge. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_panes).

column2: void * deck_select_card_draw_card_row_detailed(void *list, short x, short y, ushort width, ushort *entry)
column3: Draws one detailed list row (pane 0 in list layout, pane 1 in list layout from layout 4 up): frame plate (ui_draw_card_frame_plate at x + 0x17, resource 0x8006); thumbnail (shop_draw_card_thumb; in mode 0 tinted 0xa0ffffff, with the state as mark, for entries whose byte 5 bits 2-4 are not 4); the name in black at scale 0xc at (x + 0x1d, y + 2), width - 0x36 wide; for frames 7-8 the attribute and property icons, otherwise the attribute and race icons, level badge and ATK/DEF (shop_draw_stat_value). When width is at least 0x110, three count badges (shop_draw_results_row_badges, records copied from the template 0x000195e8): in mode 0 the template badge, the copies in list 1 (deck_count_list_copies(0x0001972c), kind 5) and the owned count (save_get_card_count, kind 6); in modes 1-2 the copies in member 0's deck list 1, or list 3 with kind 3 for fusion and synchro cards, the copies in its list 2 (deck_get_member_slot_count / deck_get_member_slot_card), each coloured 0xff0080ff when the save card list holds the card with state 1 (3 for list 3) or 2, and the copies in list 0 (deck_count_list_copies(0x0001970c)). The thumbnail copy count is shown for narrower rows and, in modes 1-2, when the active pane shows list 1. Then the check icon (shop_draw_check_icon state 2 at x + width - 0x18, y + 3) when save_test_card_byte1_flag is set and the thumbnail badges (shop_draw_card_badges; its is_new argument is save_get_card_state called with the comparison card id == 1, not with the id). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_list_rows_detailed).

column2: void deck_select_card_draw_text_px_2(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper (same code as ui_window_draw_text_px at 0x00001814): system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text), text passed through in its register. Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_draw_card_row_detailed, deck_select_card_draw_card_row_compact).

Draws the visible rows of a compact list pane (pane 1 in layouts 2-3): from the first visible index (+6) up to the visible-row count (+0x18) or the end of the list, one row per entry (deck_select_card_draw_card_row_compact at pane x + cell offset, y advancing by the row height +0x1c, width +0x1a). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_panes).

column2: void * deck_select_card_draw_card_row_compact(void *list, uint x, uint y, uint width, ushort *entry)
column3: Draws one compact list row (pane 1 in list layout of layouts 2-3): the frame plate (ui_draw_card_frame_plate with the card frame, resource 0x8006) at x + 0x1a, the thumbnail at y + 1 (shop_draw_card_thumb; in mode 0 tinted 0xa0ffffff with the item state as badge for non-movable entries), the badges (shop_draw_card_badges; its is_new argument is save_get_card_state called with the comparison card id == 1, not with the id), the card name in black at scale 0xc at (x + 0x1b, y), width - 0x1b wide (font wrapping by language); for monsters (card_db_is_monster) ATK and DEF (shop_draw_stat_value at x + 0x19, y + 0xd and y + 0x17) and the level badge (shop_draw_level_badge at x + 0x45, y + 0x14); and the check icon (shop_draw_check_icon state 2 at x + 0x4e, y + 0xd) when save_test_card_byte1_flag is set. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_list_rows_compact).

Copy of rel_shop's: binary search of value in the ascending u16 list table[1..table[0]]; returns its index, or 0 when table is NULL or value is absent. Used here with resource 0x8031 to get a card's image index. No side effects. Callers: 5 (deck_select_card_build_owned_card_list, deck_select_card_build_free_copies_list_excluding, deck_select_card_build_card_list_items, deck_select_card_build_free_copies_list, ...).

Copy of rel_deck's: counts the entries of a sorted u32 table {count, entries} whose low 16 bits equal card_id, stopping at the first larger id. Returns the count. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_filter_by_genre).

column2: int shop_find_card_art_variant(uint card_id, int variant, int *table)
column3: Copy of rel_shop's: linear search of table (count, then words) for (card_id & 0xffff) | variant << 16. Returns its index or -1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (shop_get_card_thumb_cell).

Copy of rel_shop's: maps a frame kind to a style: 0-3 unchanged, 7 -> 5, 8 -> 6, 10 -> 4, else -1. No side effects. Callers: 3 (deck_filter_by_frame, ui_draw_card_frame_plate, deck_select_card_draw_sort_group_header).

column2: void * shop_draw_small_digits(void *list, uint xy, int pad, uint value, uint style, uint colour, void *image)

Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 2 (deck_select_card_draw_pane_status, shop_draw_card_badges).

column3: Copy of rel_shop's: draws value as font digits from right to left, each moved left by step, at most digits places, without pad stopping after the most significant digit, inside an external font list. Returns the advanced list (medium). Side effects: font drawing. Callers: 3 (deck_select_card_draw_sort_group_header, ui_draw_list_tab_count, shop_draw_results_row_badges).

Same code as ui_list_window_draw_text at 0x000017f4: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 3 (shop_draw_stat_value, shop_draw_button_help, shop_draw_number_plain).

column2: void * shop_draw_cursor_frame(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height, void *image, int flags)
column3: Copy of rel_shop's: draws a cursor frame around (x, y, width, height) from image (four 6 x 6 corners, stretched edges; flags bit 3 enlarges it by 2 px). Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_overlays).

Copy of rel_shop's: when image is non-NULL draws the sprite rect {x, y, w, h, u, v} from its GIM texture with white ambient and nearest filtering. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 9 (shop_draw_race_icon, shop_draw_results_label_icon_b, shop_draw_card_badges, shop_draw_spell_trap_icon, ...).

column2: void * shop_draw_race_icon(void *list, uint xy, short race, void *image)

column2: void * shop_draw_spell_trap_icon(void *list, uint xy, short icon, void *image)
column3: Copy of rel_shop's: draws the property icon cell (u = (icon - 1) x 0x11, v = 0x33) when icon is non-zero. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_property_icon).

column2: void * shop_draw_attribute_icon(void *list, uint xy, short attribute, void *image)
column3: Copy of rel_shop's: remaps attributes 7 -> 14, 9 -> 13, 8 -> 7 and draws the cell u = ((a - 1) % 7) x 0x11, v = ((a - 1) / 7) x 0x11 + 0x44. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_select_card_draw_attribute_icon).

column2: void * shop_draw_results_label_icon_a(void *list, uint xy, ushort kind, void *image)
column3: Copy of rel_shop's: draws an icon cell for kind (u = kind x 0x11 below 4, (kind - 1) x 0x11 above 4, (0, 0x80) for 4). Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_group_header_icon_a).

column2: void * ui_draw_group_header_sprite_b(void *list, uint xy, short index, void *gim)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's: draws group-header icon index at xy (u = index x 17, fixed v and size from module data). Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_group_header_icon_b).

column2: void * shop_draw_results_label_icon_b(void *list, uint xy, short index, void *image)

column2: void * shop_draw_level_badge(void *list, uint xy, uint level, uint colour, void *image)
column3: Copy of rel_shop's: draws a 9 x 9 star and the 0x13 x 0xb number cell of level next to it. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 4 (deck_select_card_draw_sort_group_header, deck_select_card_draw_card_row_detailed, deck_select_card_draw_card_row_compact, ui_draw_cursor_card_info).

column2: void * shop_draw_stat_value(void *list, uint kind_value, uint xy, uint scale, uint colour, void *image)
